description: Structured change records (schema monity.network.change/1) for one page, one site or one tracker, newest first: page id, what changed (kind, before, after, summary), whether Monity detected it, the tracker's owner posted it or an external source posted it, when, and evidence links. A page can be given as any form of its address (www., tracking parameters and a trailing slash do not matter) or as its page id (pg_…), and every form finds the same records. Use for exact, filterable history (a date range, only price changes, only detected changes); get_network_changes is the simpler feed.

origin.description: DETECTED: Monity saw it, with evidence. HUNTER: posted by hand by the tracker's owner

page.description: A page address or page id

since.description: From this ISO 8601 date or time

site.description: Every page on a site, e.g. nike.com

until.description: Before this ISO 8601 date or time

watch.description: A one-source tracker's slug or id

name: query_network_records
title: Query Network change records
